promise: Measure small agent decisions and use a bounded fast path only where its outcome can be checked.
audience: Developers measuring agent cost, latency and bounded routing.
trigger: Select a read/list candidate, diagnose routing, or compare observed execution.

modes.name: Inspect
modes.when: A router or model service may be misconfigured.
modes.output: Native manifest, diagnose and observed execution counts.

modes.name: Select
modes.when: The caller supplies bounded eligible candidates.
modes.output: A native advisory choice or explicit abstention.

modes.name: Compare
modes.output: Recomputable outcome, cost and latency differences.

examples.title: Fictional worked example
examples.brief: A fictional task illustrating Fast Decisions.
examples.before: A router claims savings from a suggested cheaper choice.
examples.after: Matched receipts show which calls actually executed and whether the task passed.
examples.why: Advisory scores alone cannot establish execution or cost avoided.

boundaries: No speed, quality or savings improvement is claimed by packaging or offline replay.

verification.name: Functional acceptance
verification.expected: Supplied fictional tasks exercise actual mechanisms and failure boundaries.
verification.evidence: 1650 native tests passed, 70 skips before metadata rename; 18 Smart Tool regression checks passed after rename.

verification.name: Native host acceptance
verification.expected: Actual provider/host/desktop/daemon/runner acceptance for the selected adapter.
verification.evidence: No live model, real desktop transaction, invitation, deployment or production data migration was performed by this functional baseline.

sources.role: Primary retained owner history, mechanisms and records; portable method consolidates the listed entry points.

consolidation: One portable method entry with mode references; original native engines, agents and records retained as optional adapters.
publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.
